name: review-crew
description: A crew for checking finished work before it is accepted: a coordinator scopes the review, specialists inspect the code, the evidence, and the security surface, and an independent checker gates the verdict.
when_to_use: Use when a change, a pull request, or a claim needs an independent check before we call it ready.

routines.description: Run the full review crew over a change and record a ready or needs-work verdict, with the evidence behind it, before merging.
routines.name: Pre-merge gate

routines.description: Take one stated claim, find the evidence for or against it, and report only what that evidence supports.
routines.name: Claim check
